messages:
sara-support: FYI — Customer (Acme Corp) says the invoice they received is missing their PO number. They need PO on the invoice for AP to process. They provided PO: PO-45023. Invoice details: `Invoice ID: INV-489102`, Amount: $12,450.00, Paid: true (card), Tax: VAT 20%. Can finance reissue with PO or do we need credit + rebill? Customer asked if we can keep same invoice number — AP is strict about PO on invoice.
emily-billing: We generally cannot mutate an issued invoice number or its content once it's been finalized. If it's already paid, the standard workflow is: issue a credit note for the original invoice, then create a new invoice that includes the PO number. That keeps the audit trail clean.
alan-finance: Agree — credit + rebill is the safest from a tax/audit perspective. For card payments we will need to refund the original charge (refund back to card) and then collect payment on the reissued invoice. Refunds to cards take ~5-7 business days depending on processor.
mike-ops: Quick question: does the customer need the original invoice reference preserved somewhere? We can include a note on the new invoice like "Replaces INV-489102" but legally it must be a new invoice number. If they're EU VAT subjects, reissuing changes bookkeeping so finance needs to confirm.
alan-finance: Tax note — since VAT 20% is on the original, reissue as new invoice + full credit note avoids altering the original record. Tagging for audit: reason="PO added after payment".
sara-support: I just checked with Acme AP — they explicitly need the PO on the invoice PDF and prefer the new invoice to reference the original. They also requested refunds to the original card. They need the paperwork emailed to accounting@acme.example within 48 hours.
emily-billing: I'll start the workflow. Steps I'll take: 1) Create credit note CN-489102-1 for INV-489102 in the billing portal. 2) Create new invoice INV-489102-R1 with PO-45023, same line items and VAT. 3) Process refund to original card and attach refund ID to both invoices. 4) Send reissued invoice + credit note PDFs to accounting@acme.example and CC the support ticket. ETA: 24-48h.
invoices-bot: Credit memo CN-489102-1 created by @emily-billing at 1765433400. Refund scheduled: REF-77321 (processor: Stripe) — status: pending.
alan-finance: Please add these tags to the new entries: [billing-reissue, vat-20, paid-card]. I'll add an audit note explaining the reason and attach the customer's PO.
sara-support: Ticket created: SUP-2219 (attached PO document and customer confirmation). I'll update the thread once invoices and PDFs are sent. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
mike-ops: If you need me to replay payment webhooks or export the original payment id for Stripe logs, ping me and I'll attach them to the ticket.
emily-billing: Will follow up here when refund posts and when new invoice PDF is emailed.
